name: The Knapsack Problem, Three Ways
description: The knapsack problem in theory, then solved two ways: an exact 0/1 dynamic-programming table (alongside longest common subsequence) and a greedy solution for the fractional version.
highlights: Brute force O(2ⁿ) vs. the Θ(nW) optimal-substructure formulation
0/1 knapsack and LCS as DP tables, with the filled tables printed
Fractional knapsack: greedy by value density, taking part of the last item
